run_checkers_cli: run checkers via CLI with comma-separated names like copies,modular_conversion,doc_toc and optional --fix flag
run_single_checker: run a single checker by name such as copies, modular_conversion, or doc_toc with optional --fix mode
check_dependency_versions_table: check or fix the dependency versions table by comparing src/transformers/dependency_versions_table.py against setup.py
test_public_imports: test that all public imports in transformers work by running from transformers import * and verifying no import errors
run_ruff_linting_and_formatting: run ruff check for linting and ruff format for code formatting across the project with optional --fix mode
